{{Lunisolar September}} 
'''September 8''' is the 8th day of month {{ill|September (Lunisolar)|ja|9月 (旧暦)|lt=September (Nagatsuki)}}  the 9th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|Butsumetsu|ja|仏滅|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10886789}} .

* {{ill|Tianshou|ja|天授 (武周)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10939678}}  1st year（{{ill|Julian calendar|en|Julian calendar|qid=Q11184|lt=Julian calendar}} {{ill|690|en|690|qid=Q23472|lt=690}} {{ill|October 16|en|October 16|qid=Q2963|lt=October 16}} ） – {{ill|Wu Zetian|en|Wu Zetian|qid=Q9738|lt=Wu Zetian}}  がEmperor・{{ill|Yejong|en|Yejong|qid=Q711037|lt=Ruizong (Tang)}}  を廃し、Emperorに即位して国号を “{{ill|Zhou dynasty|en|Zhou dynasty|qid=Q35216|lt=Zhou}} ” とする
* {{ill|Ansei|en|Ansei|qid=Q1327259|lt=Ansei}} 6th year（{{ill|Gregorian calendar|en|Gregorian calendar|qid=Q12138|lt=Gregorian calendar}} {{ill|1859|en|1859|qid=Q7687|lt=1859}} {{ill|October 3|en|October 3|qid=Q2931|lt=October 3}} ） – {{ill|Sonzōha|ja|Sonnō jōi faction}}  の {{ill|Obama Domain|en|Obama Domain|qid=Q1088442|lt=Obama-han}}  士・{{ill|Umeda Unpin|ja|梅田雲浜|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q6561334}}  を京都で捕縛。{{ill|Ansei Purge|en|Ansei Purge|qid=Q569487|lt=Ansei no Daigoku}}  が始まる
